narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Forty nine is seven squared. Two and three add up, so it is seven to the power five.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Forty nine cubed is three forty nines multiplied, so three lots of seven squared.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two and two and two make six, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 49³ = 7⁵; 49 × 49 × 49 is written as 7² × 7² × 7²; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, find each answer on the power line.
<bookmark mark='walk'/>Multiplying moves right along the line, and dividing moves left.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line find your answer on the power line appears; the check line multiply moves right, divide moves left appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says forty nine cubed is seven to the power five, because two and three add to five. Cubing multiplies the exponent by three, giving six, so the bubble is struck.
